_comment: Pi.dev Starter Kit — Project-level feature flags. Copy to .pi/settings.json and customize.

starterKit._permissionMode_comment: 'default' shows a diff for every file edit and requires [y/N] approval. 'acceptEdits' auto-approves file edits but still gates bash commands. 'featureWork' auto-approves read/write/edit and bash commands scoped to the active project; git commit, git push, network commands, protected paths, and outside-project paths still ask/block.

featureWork._comment: /feature-mode on and feature_mode_toggle({mode:'on'}) persist starterKit.permissionMode='featureWork' into this project's .pi/settings.json. Auto-allow is project-scoped to the active session cwd only.

starterKit._activeExtensions_comment: Extensions to load. Keep 'permission-gate' before 'rtk-rewrite' so security decisions happen before optimization. 'graphify' is passive unless graphify-out/ exists. Remove any you don't want. Optional extras: 'lsp-bridge', 'monitor-bash', 'artifact-read', 'ast-tools', 'source-navigation'. Add custom extensions placed in .pi/extensions/. starter-kit-doctor reports available capabilities.

rtkRewrite._comment: RTK rewrites agent bash commands for token/context savings. Requires rtk in PATH. The starter-kit extension means you do not need to run `rtk init --agent pi`; set enabled=false to disable permanently.

contribGate._mode_comment: 'default' warns on violations. 'strict' blocks until fixed.

starterKit._autoLint_comment: Run the project linter/formatter (with --fix) after every edit or write. Disable if no linter is configured.
starterKit._autoTypeCheck_comment: Run incremental type-checking (tsc --noEmit, pyright, cargo check) after every edit. Requires lsp-bridge extension to be in activeExtensions.

lspBridge._enableSymbolOps_comment: Enable LSP symbol operations: go-to-definition, find-references, rename preview, workspace symbols. TypeScript only. Set false to disable.

starterKit._autoVerify_comment: Run tests after every change set and compare output against spec. Requires the self-verify skill to be in activeSkills.
starterKit._activeSkills_comment: Skills available to the agent. Optional extras: 'browser-testing', 'mcp-orchestration', 'ai-memory', 'graphify'. Skills register tools on activation and deregister on completion (progressive disclosure).
starterKit._steeringMode_comment: Agent steering behavior. 'polished-default' works well for most projects. 'strict' locks the plan until human intervenes. 'loose' lets the agent self-correct freely. 'audit-heavy' requires human approval for every step.
starterKit._interruptMode_comment: How the harness handles user interrupts. 'safe-steer' pauses and asks on potential risk. 'soft' suggests corrections but continues. 'hard' always stops for human input.
starterKit._compactionStrategy_comment: Compaction behavior. 'context-mode-default' uses SQLite+FTS5 session continuity. 'aggressive' compacts earlier for long sessions. 'conservative' keeps more context for complex tasks.

aiMemory._enabled_comment: Set true after running /setup-ai-memory. The service runs continuously via upstream server + hooks; this flag documents project intent.

starterKit._webSearch_comment: 'cached' returns pre-indexed results (fast, low token usage). 'live' fetches fresh results. 'disabled' turns off web search entirely.
